Development Rights utilized by the improvements located on Seller's Land on the date hereof excluding the Retained Development Rights (as such term is defined below). G. The parties hereto have been advised that on the date hereof Seller's Existing Building uses less than the maximum Floor Area Development Rights that are permitted for development on Seller's Land pursuant to the Zoning Resolution, and that, therefore, Seller has available the Excess Development Rights that,under procedures currently available under the Zoning Resolution, may be made available to permit the construction of Developer's Proposed Building with Floor Area greater than that which would be permitted if the Excess Development Rights were not so made available. H. Seller wishes to sell in perpetuity to Developer, and Developer wishes to permitted to have Floor Area greater than that which would be permitted if the Excess owner of the Excess Development Rights. The parties hereto (among others) have simultaneously herewith executed and delivered a certain Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the“Declaration"), which is intended to be submitted contemporaneously herewith for recording in the New York County Office of the Register of The City of New York with respect to the Combined Zoning Lot.  J. Seller's Land is contiguous with Developer's Land for at least ten (10) linear feet, and Seller's Land and Developer's Land are all within a single block. NOW,THEREFORE, the parties agrees as follows: ARTICLE1 GRANTOFDEVELOPMENTRIGHTS Section1.1 Excess Development Rights, to the extent permitted by applicable law. Notwithstanding anything herein to the contrary, it is understood and agreed that Seller is retaining for its benefit (i) all Floor Area Development Rights and all other developments rights pertaining to Seller's Property arising on or after the date hereof by any means, including, but not limited to, a modification or amendment of the Zoning Resolution or other change in existing law or an upward revision by the City of New York of the allowable Floor Area Ratio; and (i) all Floor Area Development Rights and other development rights pertaining to Seller's Property as same exists on the date hereof in order to preserve the existing height, Floor Area Ratio, bulk, room count and configuration of Seller's Existing Building in excess of the Excess Development Rights (collectively, the “Retained Development Rights").
